observations.date_semantics: Positive annual revenue supports reported operation sometime during FY2023. A period-end balance sheet is not proof of operation on exactly December 31. Native publication date and exact last-positive date remain unresolved.

facts: Native summary cash is reported as of November 2023, while MD&A cash is as of December 31, 2023; these are distinct dates.
The trailing-three-month revenue statement reports 22000 USD/month. Its interval is not independently specified and must not be assigned to Q4 2023 or combined with the annual total.
The 2023 financial PDF auditor report is dated April 23, 2024; Note 12 reports a subsequent-events evaluation date of April 23, 2023. Preserve this apparent internal discrepancy.

observations.finding: The prior source packet did not establish sapientx.ai continuity. Its product-key/billing date is not verified issuer operation. This review supplies no new .ai bridge or replacement endpoint.

limitations: One purposefully selected issuer is not a cohort or representative sample.
Source retrieval, filing dates, audit dates, period ends and financing labels are not interchangeable outcome clocks.
Matching annual financial values across the native page and issuer filing is one issuer factual lineage.
A native financial reporting period does not itself prove continuous survival or current operation.
No first-live date, successful-close clock, independent-operation state or index-success target was newly adjudicated.
